Ahl-e-Kitab ki mauzoo riwayatein: Qaf huroof-e-hija se hai jo suraton ke awwal mein aate hain jaise Sad, Noon, Alif-Laam-Meem, Ha-Meem, Ta-Seen, waghera. Hum ne in ki poori tashreeh Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein shuru mein kar di hai. Ba'az salaf ka qaul hai ke Qaf ek pahar hai jo zameen ko ghere hue hai, main to jaanta hoon ke darasal yeh Bani Israel ki khurafaat mein se hai jinhein ba'az logon ne le liya. Yeh samajh kar ke yeh riwayat lena mubah hai go tasdeeq-o-takzeeb nahin kar sakte. Lekin mera khayal hai ke yeh aur is jaisi aur riwayatein to Bani Israel ke bad-deeno ne ghar li hongi taake logon par deen ko khalt-malt kar dein. Aap khayal kijiye ke is ummat mein bawajood-e-ke ulama-e-kiram aur hafizan-e-izam ki bahut bari deendar mukhlis jama'at har zamane mein maujood hai, taham bad-deeno ne bahut thori muddat mein mauzoo ahadees tak ghar lein. Pas Bani Israel jin par muddatein guzar chukin, jo hifz se aari thay, jin mein naqqadan-e-fan maujood na thay, jo Kalam-e-Allah ko asliyat se hata diya karte thay, jo sharabon mein makhmur raha karte thay, jo Aayat-e-Allah ko badal dala karte thay, un ka kya theek hai? Pas hadees ne jin riwayaton ko un se lena mubah rakha hai, yeh woh hain jo kam az kam aql-o-fahm mein to aa sakein, na woh jo sareeh khilaf-e-aql hon, sunte hi un ke batil aur ghalat hone ka faisla aql kar deti ho aur us ka jhoot hona itna wazeh ho ke us par daleel lane ki zaroorat na pare. Pas mandaraja-bala riwayat bhi aisi hi hai, wallahu a'alam. Afsos ke bahut salaf-o-khalaf ne Ahl-e-Kitab se is qisam ki hikayatein Quran Majeed ki tafsir mein warid kar di hain. Darasal Quran-e-Kareem aisi besaro-pa baton ka kuch mohtaj nahin, falhamdulillah. Yahan tak ke Imam Abu Muhammad Abdur Rahman bin Abu Hatim Razi (R.H) ne bhi yahan ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar ba-riwayat Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) warid kar diya hai jo az-ru-e-sanad sabit nahin. Is mein hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne ek samundar paida kiya hai jo is saari zameen ko ghere hue hai aur us samundar ke peeche ek pahar hai jo us ko roke hue hai, us ka naam Qaf hai, aasman aur duniya isi par utha hua hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne us pahar ke peeche ek zameen banai hai jo is zameen se saat guna bari hai, phir us ke peeche ek samundar hai jo use ghere hue hai, phir us ke peeche pahar hai jo use ghere hue hai, use bhi Qaf kehte hain, doosra aasman isi par buland kiya hua hai. Isi tarah saat zameenein, saat samundar, saat pahar aur saat aasman ginuwaye, phir yeh aayat parhi: (Wa-al-bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu abhurim ma nafidat kalimatullahi innallaha Azizun Hakim) (31:27).

(Luqman: 27) Is asar ki asnaad mein inqita hai. Ali bin Abu Talha jo riwayat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se karte hain us mein hai ke (Qaf) Allah ke naamon mein se ek naam hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain (Qaf) bhi misl (Saad, Noon, Ta-Seen, Alif-Laam-Meem) waghera ke huroof-e-hija mein se hai. Pas in riwayaat se bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka yeh farman hona aur ba'eed ho jata hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke kaam ka faisla kar diya gaya hai, qasam Allah ki aur (Qaf) keh kar baqi jumla chhor diya gaya ke yeh daleel hai mehzoof par, jaise shayar kehta hai: Qultu laha qifi faqalat Qaf. Lekin yeh kehna bhi theek nahin, is liye ke mehzoof par dalalat karne wala kalam saaf hona chahiye aur yahan kaunsa kalam hai? Jis se itne bade jumle ke mehzoof hone ka pata chale. Phir is karam aur azmat wale Quran ki qasam khai jis ke aage se ya peeche se baatil nahin aa sakta, jo hikmaton aur tareefon wale Allah ki taraf se nazil hua hai. Is qasam ka jawab kya hai? Is mein bhi kai qaul hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne to ba'az nahwiyon se naqal kiya hai ke is ka jawab aayat (Qad alimna) poori aayat tak hai, lekin yeh bhi gaur talab hai. Balkeh jawab-e-qasam ke baad ka mazmoon kalam hai, yani nabuwwat aur dobara jee uthne ka suboot aur tehqeeq, go lafzon se qasam is ka jawab nahin batati ho, lekin Quran mein jawab mein aksar do qasmein maujood hain jaise ke Surah Saad ki tafsir ke shuru mein guzar chuka hai, isi tarah yahan bhi hai. Phir farmata hai ke unhon ne is baat par ta'ajjub zahir kiya hai ke inhi mein se ek insaan kaise Rasool ban gaya? Jaise aur aayat mein hai: Aayat (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an au-haina ila rajulim minhum an an-zirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubeen) (Yunus: 2), yani kya logon ko is baat par ta'ajjub hua ke hum ne inhi mein se ek shakhs ki taraf wahi bheji taake tum logon ko khabardar kar de. Yani darasal yeh koi ta'ajjub ki cheez na thi, Allah jise chahe apne farishton mein se apni risalat ke liye chun leta hai aur jise chahe insaanon mein se chun leta hai. Isi ke sath yeh bhi bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne marne ke baad jeene ko bhi ta'ajjub ki nigahon se dekha aur kaha ke jab hum mar jayenge aur hamare jism ke ajza juda juda ho kar reza reza ho kar mitti ho jayenge, us ke baad to isi haiyat-o-tarkeeb mein hamara dobara jeena bilkul muhaal hai. Is ke jawab mein farman sadir hua ke zameen in ke jismon ko jo kha jati hai us se bhi hum ghafil nahin, humein maloom hai ke in ke zarre kahan gaye aur kis halat mein kahan hain? Hamare paas kitab hai jo is ki hafiz hai, hamara ilm in sab maloomat par mushtamil hai aur sath hi kitab mein mehfooz hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yani in ke gosht, chamde, haddiyan aur baal jo kuch zameen kha jati hai hamare ilm mein hai.

Phir Parwardigar-e-Alam unke is mahal samajhne ki asal wajah bayan farma raha hai ke darasal yeh haq ko jhutlane wale log hain aur jo log apne paas haq ke aa jane ke baad is ka inkar kardein un se achi samajh hi chhin jati hai. Mareej ke ma'ani hain mukhtalif, muztarib, munkir aur khalt-malt ke, jaise farman hai ayat (Innakum lafi qawlim mukhtalif) (Az-Zariyat: 8) yani yaqeenan tum ek jhagde ki baat mein pade hue ho. Na-farmani wahi karta hai jo bhalai se mehroom kardiya gaya hai.

Pas mandaraja-bala riwayat bhi aisi hi hai, wallahu a'alam. Afsos ke bahut salaf-o-khalaf ne Ahl-e-Kitab se is qisam ki hikayatein Quran Majeed ki tafsir mein warid kar di hain. Darasal Quran-e-Kareem aisi besaro-pa baton ka kuch mohtaj nahin, falhamdulillah. Yahan tak ke Imam Abu Muhammad Abdur Rahman bin Abu Hatim Razi (R.H) ne bhi yahan ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar ba-riwayat Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) warid kar diya hai jo az-ru-e-sanad sabit nahin. Is mein hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne ek samundar paida kiya hai jo is saari zameen ko ghere hue hai aur us samundar ke peeche ek pahar hai jo us ko roke hue hai, us ka naam Qaf hai, aasman aur duniya isi par utha hua hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne us pahar ke peeche ek zameen banai hai jo is zameen se saat guna bari hai, phir us ke peeche ek samundar hai jo use ghere hue hai, phir us ke peeche pahar hai jo use ghere hue hai, use bhi Qaf kehte hain, doosra aasman isi par buland kiya hua hai. Isi tarah saat zameenein, saat samundar, saat pahar aur saat aasman ginuwaye, phir yeh aayat parhi: (Wa-al-bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu abhurim ma nafidat kalimatullahi innallaha Azizun Hakim) (31:27).

(Luqman: 27) Is asar ki asnaad mein inqita hai. Ali bin Abu Talha jo riwayat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se karte hain us mein hai ke (Qaf) Allah ke naamon mein se ek naam hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain (Qaf) bhi misl (Saad, Noon, Ta-Seen, Alif-Laam-Meem) waghera ke huroof-e-hija mein se hai. Pas in riwayaat se bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka yeh farman hona aur ba'eed ho jata hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke kaam ka faisla kar diya gaya hai, qasam Allah ki aur (Qaf) keh kar baqi jumla chhor diya gaya ke yeh daleel hai mehzoof par, jaise shayar kehta hai: Qultu laha qifi faqalat Qaf. Lekin yeh kehna bhi theek nahin, is liye ke mehzoof par dalalat karne wala kalam saaf hona chahiye aur yahan kaunsa kalam hai? Jis se itne bade jumle ke mehzoof hone ka pata chale. Phir is karam aur azmat wale Quran ki qasam khai jis ke aage se ya peeche se baatil nahin aa sakta, jo hikmaton aur tareefon wale Allah ki taraf se nazil hua hai. Is qasam ka jawab kya hai? Is mein bhi kai qaul hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne to ba'az nahwiyon se naqal kiya hai ke is ka jawab aayat (Qad alimna) poori aayat tak hai, lekin yeh bhi gaur talab hai. Phir farmata hai ke unhon ne is baat par ta'ajjub zahir kiya hai ke inhi mein se ek insaan kaise Rasool ban gaya? Jaise aur aayat mein hai: Aayat (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an au-haina ila rajulim minhum an an-zirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qalal-kafiruna inna haza lasahirum mubeen) (Yunus: 2), yani kya logon ko is baat par ta'ajjub hua ke hum ne inhi mein se ek shakhs ki taraf wahi bheji taake tum logon ko khabardar kar de. Yani darasal yeh koi ta'ajjub ki cheez na thi, Allah jise chahe apne farishton mein se apni risalat ke liye chun leta hai aur jise chahe insaanon mein se chun leta hai. Isi ke sath yeh bhi bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne marne ke baad jeene ko bhi ta'ajjub ki nigahon se dekha aur kaha ke jab hum mar jayenge aur hamare jism ke ajza juda juda ho kar reza reza ho kar mitti ho jayenge, us ke baad to isi haiyat-o-tarkeeb mein hamara dobara jeena bilkul muhaal hai. Is ke jawab mein farman sadir hua ke zameen in ke jismon ko jo kha jati hai us se bhi hum ghafil nahin, humein maloom hai ke in ke zarre kahan gaye aur kis halat mein kahan hain? Hamare paas kitab hai jo is ki hafiz hai, hamara ilm in sab maloomat par mushtamil hai aur sath hi kitab mein mehfooz hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yani in ke gosht, chamde, haddiyan aur baal jo kuch zameen kha jati hai hamare ilm mein hai.

Na-farmani wahi karta hai jo bhalai se mehroom kardiya gaya hai.

In ko shamat-e-a'maal hi shud thi. Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Makkah ko un azabon se dara raha hai jo un jaise jhutlane walon par un se pehle aa chuke hain, jaise ke Nuh A.S ki qoum jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne pani mein gharq kar diya aur Ashab-e-Rass jin ka poora qissa Surah Furqan ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai aur Thamud aur Aad aur ummat-e-Lut jise zameen mein dhansa diya aur us zameen ko sara hua daldal bana diya. Yeh sab kya tha? Un ke kufr, un ki sarkashi, aur mukhalifat-e-haq ka natija tha. Ashab-e-Aikah se murad qoum-e-Shuaib hai (Alaihis Salam) aur qoum-e-Tubba se murad Yamani hain, Surah Dukhan mein un ka waqia bhi guzar chuka hai aur wahin is ki poori tafsir hai, yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahin, falhamdulillah. In tamam ummaton ne apne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki thi aur azab-e-Allah se halak kar diye gaye, yahi Allah ka usool jaari hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke ek rasool ka jhutlane wala tamam rasoolon ka munkir hai, jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jalla-wa-Ala ka farman hai: (Kazabat qawmu Nuhinil mursaleen) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 105). Qoum-e-Nuh ne rasoolon ka inkar kiya halankeh un ke paas sirf Nuh A.S hi aaye thay. Pas darasal yeh thay aise ke agar un ke paas tamam rasool aa jate to yeh sab ko jhutlate, ek ko bhi na maante, sab ki takzeeb karte, ek ki bhi tasdeeq na karte. Un sab par Allah ke azab ka wada un ke kartooton ki wajah se sabit ho gaya aur sadiq aa gaya. Pas Ahl-e-Makkah aur deegar mukhatib logon ko bhi is bad-khaslat se parhez karna chahiye, kahin aisa na ho ke azab ka kora un par bhi baras pade. Kya jab yeh kuch na thay un ka basana hum par bhari pada tha? Jo ab dobara paida karne ke munkir ho rahe hain, ibtida se to iaada bahut hi aasaan hua karta hai, jaise farman hai: (Wa huwallazi yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'iduhu wa huwa ahwanu alaih, wa lahul masalul a'la fis samawati wal ard, wa huwal Azizul Hakim) (Surah (Ar-Rum: 27). Ya'ni ibtidaan usi ne paida kiya hai aur dobara bhi wahi iaada karega aur yeh us par bahut aasaan hai. Surah Yaseen mein farman-e-Ilahi Jalla Jalaluhu guzar chuka ke: (Wa daraba lana masalan wa nasiya khalqahu, qala man yuhyil izama wa hiya rameem) (Surah (Yaseen: 78). Ya'ni apni paidaish ko bhool kar hamare samne misalein bayan karne laga aur kehne laga boseeda sari gali haddiyon ko kaun zinda karega? In ko to jawab de ke woh jis ne inhe pehli baar paida kiya aur tamam khalq ko janta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mujhe Bani Adam eeza deta hai jab yeh kehta hai ke Allah mujhe dobara paida nahin kar sakta, halankeh pehli dafa paida karna dobara paida karne se kuch aasaan nahin.)))

Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Makkah ko un azabon se dara raha hai jo un jaise jhutlane walon par un se pehle aa chuke hain, jaise ke Nuh A.S ki qoum jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne pani mein gharq kar diya aur Ashab-e-Rass jin ka poora qissa Surah Furqan ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai aur Thamud aur Aad aur ummat-e-Lut jise zameen mein dhansa diya aur us zameen ko sara hua daldal bana diya. Yeh sab kya tha? Un ke kufr, un ki sarkashi, aur mukhalifat-e-haq ka natija tha. Ashab-e-Aikah se murad qoum-e-Shuaib hai (Alaihis Salam) aur qoum-e-Tubba se murad Yamani hain, Surah Dukhan mein un ka waqia bhi guzar chuka hai aur wahin is ki poori tafsir hai, yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahin, falhamdulillah. In tamam ummaton ne apne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki thi aur azab-e-Allah se halak kar diye gaye, yahi Allah ka usool jaari hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke ek rasool ka jhutlane wala tamam rasoolon ka munkir hai, jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jalla-wa-Ala ka farman hai: (Kazabat qawmu Nuhinil mursaleen) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 105). Qoum-e-Nuh ne rasoolon ka inkar kiya halankeh un ke paas sirf Nuh A.S hi aaye thay. Pas darasal yeh thay aise ke agar un ke paas tamam rasool aa jate to yeh sab ko jhutlate, ek ko bhi na maante, sab ki takzeeb karte, ek ki bhi tasdeeq na karte. Un sab par Allah ke azab ka wada un ke kartooton ki wajah se sabit ho gaya aur sadiq aa gaya. Pas Ahl-e-Makkah aur deegar mukhatib logon ko bhi is bad-khaslat se parhez karna chahiye, kahin aisa na ho ke azab ka kora un par bhi baras pade. Kya jab yeh kuch na thay un ka basana hum par bhari pada tha? Jo ab dobara paida karne ke munkir ho rahe hain, ibtida se to iaada bahut hi aasaan hua karta hai, jaise farman hai: (Wa huwallazi yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'iduhu wa huwa ahwanu alaih, wa lahul masalul a'la fis samawati wal ard, wa huwal Azizul Hakim) (Surah (Ar-Rum: 27). Ya'ni ibtidaan usi ne paida kiya hai aur dobara bhi wahi iaada karega aur yeh us par bahut aasaan hai. Surah Yaseen mein farman-e-Ilahi Jalla Jalaluhu guzar chuka ke: (Wa daraba lana masalan wa nasiya khalqahu, qala man yuhyil izama wa hiya rameem) (Surah (Yaseen: 78). Ya'ni apni paidaish ko bhool kar hamare samne misalein bayan karne laga aur kehne laga boseeda sari gali haddiyon ko kaun zinda karega? In ko to jawab de ke woh jis ne inhe pehli baar paida kiya aur tamam khalq ko janta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mujhe Bani Adam eeza deta hai jab yeh kehta hai ke Allah mujhe dobara paida nahin kar sakta, halankeh pehli dafa paida karna dobara paida karne se kuch aasaan nahin.)))

Dain aur bayin do farishtay. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke wohi insaan ka khaliq hai aur us ka ilm tamam cheezon ka ihata kiye hue hai, yahan tak ke insaan ke dil mein jo bhale bure khayalat paida hote hain unhein bhi woh jaanta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ke dil mein jo khayalat ayen un se darguzar farma liya hai jab tak ke woh zaban se na nikalein ya amal na karein. Aur hum us ki rag-e-jaan se bhi zyada us ke nazdeek hain, yani hamare farishtay. Aur baaz ne kaha hai hamara ilm. Un ki gharz yeh hai ke kahin hulool aur ittehad na lazim ajaye jo bil-ijma us Rabb ki muqaddas zaat se ba'eed hai aur woh us se bilkul paak hai. Lekin lafz ka iqtiza yeh nahin hai, is liye ke (wa-ana) nahin kaha balkay (wa-nahnu) kaha hai, yani main nahin kaha balkay hum kaha hai. Yehi lafz us shakhs ke bare mein kahe gaye hain jis ki maut qareeb agayi ho aur woh naz'a ke alam mein ho. Farman hai ayat (wa-nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum) al-kh, yani hum tum sab se zyada us se qareeb hain lekin tum nahin dekhte. Yahan bhi murad farishton ka is qadar qareeb hona hai. Jaise farman hai ayat (Inna nahnu nazzalna-dh-dhikra wa inna lahu la-hafizun) (Al-Hijr: 9), yani hum ne zikr ko nazil farmaya aur hum hi us ke muhafiz bhi hain. Farishtay hi zikr Quran-e-Kareem ko le kar nazil hue hain aur yahan bhi murad farishton ki itni nazdeki hai jis par Allah ne unhein qudrat bakhsh rakhi hai. Pas insaan par ek pehra farishtay ka hota hai aur ek shaitan ka. Isi tarah shaitan bhi jism-e-insaan mein isi tarah phirta hai jis tarah khoon, jaise ke sachon ke sachay Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai. Is liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke do farishtay jo dain bayin baithe hain woh tumhare aamal likh rahe hain. Ibn-e-Adam ke munh se jo kalma nikalta hai use mehfooz rakhne wale aur use na chhorne wale aur foran likh lene wale farishtay muqarrar hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa inna alaikum la-hafizin) (Al-Infitar: 10), tum par muhafiz hain buzurg farishtay jo tumhare fe'l se ba-khabar hain aur likhne wale hain. Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Qatada to farmate hain yeh farishtay har nek-o-bad amal likh liya karte hain. Ibn-e-Abbas ke do qaul hain, ek to yehi hai, dusra qaul aap ka yeh hai ke sawab-o-azab likh liya karte hain. Lekin ayat ke zahiri alfaz pehle qaul ki hi ta'eed karte hain kyunke farman hai jo lafz nikalta hai us ke paas muhafiz tayyar hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai insaan ek kalma Allah ki razamandi ka keh guzarta hai jise woh koi bahut bara ajr ka kalma nahin jaanta lekin Allah Ta'ala us ki wajah se apni razamandi us ke liye Qayamat tak ki likh deta hai. Aur koi burai ka kalma narazgi-e-Allah ka isi tarah be-parwahi se keh guzarta hai jis ki wajah se Allah apni narazi us par apni mulaqat ke din tak ki likh deta hai. Hazrat Alqama farmate hain is hadith ne mujhe bahut si baton se bacha liya.

Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi isay hasan batlatay hain. Ahnaf bin Qais farmatay hain dayin taraf wala nekiyan likhta hai aur yeh bayin taraf walay par ameen hai. Jab banday se koi khata ho jati hai to yeh kehta hai thehar ja, agar us ne usi waqt tauba kar li to usay likhnay nahin deta aur agar us ne tauba na ki to woh likh leta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Imam Hasan Basri is ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmatay thay, aye Ibn-e-Adam! Teray liye sahifa khol diya gaya hai aur do buzurg farishtay tujh par muqarrar kar diye gaye hain, ek teray dahinay dusra bayin. Dayin taraf wala to teri nekiyon ki hifazat karta hai aur bayin taraf wala buraiyon ko dekhta rehta hai, ab tu jo chahay amal kar, kami kar ya ziyadati kar. Jab tu maray ga to yeh daftar lapet diya jaye ga aur teray sath teri qabr mein rakh diya jaye ga aur Qayamat ke din jab tu apni qabr se uthay ga to yeh teray samnay pesh kar diya jaye ga. Isi ko Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kullu insānin alzamnāhu ṭā'irahū fī 'unuqihī wa nukhriju lahū yaumal-qiyāmati kitābay-yalqāhu manshūrā) (Al-Isra: 13). Har insaan ki shamat-e-a'maal ki tafseel hum ne us ke galay laga di hai aur hum Qayamat ke din us ke samnay namah-e-a'maal ki ek kitab phenk denge jisay woh khuli hui payega. Phir us se kahenge ke apni kitab parh le, aaj tu khud hi apna hisab lenay ko kafi hai. Phir Hazrat Hasan ne farmaya, Allah ki qasam us ne bara hi adl kiya jis ne khud tujhay hi tera muhasib bana diya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmatay hain jo kuch tu bhala bura kalma zaban se nikalta hai woh sab likha jata hai, yahan tak ke tera yeh kehna bhi ke main ne khaya, main ne piya, main gaya, main aaya, main ne dekha. Phir Jumerat walay din us ke aqwal-o-af'aal pesh kiye jatay hain, khair-o-shar baqi rakh li jati hai aur sab kuch mita diya jata hai. Yehi ma'ani hain farman-e-Bari Ta'ala Shanahu ke (Yamḥullāhu mā yashā'u wa yuthbitu wa 'indahū ummul-kitāb) (Ar-Ra'd: 39). Hazrat Imam Ahmad ki babat marwi hai ke aap apne marz-ul-maut mein karah rahay thay to aap ko maloom hua ke Hazrat Ta'oos farmatay hain ke farishtay isay bhi likhtay hain, chunancha aap ne karahna bhi chor diya. Allah aap par apni rahmat nazil farmaye, apni maut ke waqt tak uff bhi na ki.

Phir farmata hai, "Ae insaan! Maut ki behoshi yaqeenan aayegi." Is waqt woh shak door ho jayega jis mein aaj-kal tu mubtala hai. Is waqt tujh se kaha jayega ki yahi hai jis se tu bhagta phirta tha. Ab woh aa gayi, toh kisi tarah is se nijaat nahin pa sakta, na bach sakta hai, na ise rok sakta hai, na ise dafa kar sakta hai, na taal sakta hai, na muqabla kar sakta hai, na kisi ki madad-o-sifarish kuch kaam aa sakti hai. Sahih yahi hai ki yahan khitab mutlaq insaan se hai, agarche baaz ne kaha hai kafir se hai aur baaz ne kuch aur bhi kaha hai. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain, "Main apne walid (Abu Bakr R.A) ke aakhri waqt mein aap ke sarhane baithi thi, aap par ghashi tari hui toh main ne yeh bait padha: 'Man la yazalu dam'uhu saqna'an fa innahu la budda marratan madfooq' (Matlab yeh hai ki jis ke aansu thehre hue hain woh bhi ek martaba tapak padenge). Toh aap ne apna sar utha kar kaha, 'Pyari bachi! Yun nahin, balki jis tarah Allah ne farmaya: (Waja'at sakratul mauti bil haqqi zalika ma kunta minhu tahid) (Surah (Qaf: 19)'." Aur riwayat mein bait ka padhna aur Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ka yeh farmana marwi hai ki yun nahin balki yeh aayat padho. Is asar ke aur bhi bahut se tareeq hain jinhein main ne Seerat-us-Siddiq mein aap ki wafat ke bayan mein jama kar diya hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab maut ki ghashi tari hone lagi toh aap apne chehra-e-mubarak se paseena ponchhte jate aur farmate jate, "SubhanAllah! Maut ki badi sakhtiyan hain."

Is aayat ke pichhle jumle ki tafseer do tarah ki gayi hai: Ek toh yeh ki (Ma) mausoola hai, yani yeh wohi hai jise tu ba'eed-az-imkaan janta tha. Dusra qaul yeh hai ki yahan (Ma) nafiya hai, toh ma'ani yeh honge ki yeh woh cheez hai jis ke juda karne ki, jis se bachne ki tujhe qudrat nahin, tu is se hat nahin sakta. Mu'ajam-e-Kabeer Tabrani mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Us shakhs ki misaal jo maut se bhagta hai, us lomdi jaisi hai jis se zameen apna qarza talab karne lagi aur yeh us se bhagne lagi. Bhagte-bhagte jab thak gayi aur bilkul chakna-choor ho gayi toh apne bhat mein ja ghusi. Zameen chunke wahan bhi maujood thi, us ne lomdi se kaha, 'Mera qarza de', toh yeh wahan se phir bhagi, saans phoola hua tha, haal bura ho raha tha, aakhir yunhi bhagte-bhagte bedam ho kar mar gayi." Al-gharaz, jis tarah us lomdi ko zameen se bhagne ki raahein band thin, isi tarah insaan ko maut se bachne ke raaste band hain.

Is ke baad soor phoonke jaane ka zikr hai, jis ki poori tafseer wali hadith guzar chuki hai. Aur hadith mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Main kis tarah rahat-o-aaram hasil kar sakta hoon halanke soor phoonkne wale farishte ne soor munh mein le liya hai aur gardan jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka intezar kar raha hai ki kab hukm mile aur kab woh phoonk de." Sahaba ne kaha, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hum kya kahein?" Aap ne farmaya, "Kaho: (Wa qalu hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel) (Surah (Al-Imran: 173)."

(Surah (Al-Imran: 173) Phir farmata hai har shakhs ke sath ek farishta toh maidan-e-mahshar ki taraf lane wala hoga aur ek farishta uske a'maal ki gawahi dene wala hoga. Zahir-e-ayat yahi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ne is ayat ki tilawat mimbar par ki aur farmaya ek chalane wala jiske hamrah yeh maidan-e-mahshar mein aayega aur ek gawah hoga jo uske a'maal ki shahadat dega. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain 'Sa'iq' se murad farishta hai aur 'Shaheed' se murad amal hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai 'Sa'iq' farishton mein se honge aur 'Shaheed' se murad khud insaan hai jo apne upar aap gawahi dega. Phir iske baad ki ayat mein jo khitab hai uski nisbat teen qaul hain. Ek toh yeh ke yeh khitab kafir se hoga, dusra yeh ke isse murad aam insaan hain nek-o-bad sab, teesra yeh ke isse murad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hain. Dusre qaul ki taujeeh yeh hai ke aakhirat aur duniya mein wahi nisbat hai jo bedari aur khwab mein hai aur teesre qaul ka matlab yeh hai ke tu is Quran ki wahi se pehle ghaflat mein tha. Humne yeh Quran nazil farma kar teri aankhon par se parda hata diya aur teri nazar qawi ho gayi. Lekin alfaaz-e-Qurani se toh zahir yahi hai ke isse murad aam hai yani har shakhs se kaha jayega ke tu is din se ghafil tha isliye ke Qayamat ke din har shakhs ki aankhein khoob khul jayengi yahan tak ke kafir bhi istiqamat par ho jayega lekin yeh istiqamat use nafa na degi jaise farman-e-Bari hai ayat (ASMI' BIHIM WA ABSIR, YAUMA YA'TUNANA LAKINIZ-ZALIMUNAL-YAUMA FI DALALIM-MUBIN) (Surah (Maryam: 38), yani jis roz yeh hamare paas aayenge khoob dekhte sunte honge aur ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZIL-MUJRIMUNA NAKISU RU'USIHIM INDA RABBIHIM, RABBANA ABSARNA WA SAMI'NA FARJI'NA NA'MAL SALIHAN INNA MUQINUN) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 12), yani kaash ke tu dekhta jab gunahgar log apne Rab ke samne sar-nigoon pade honge aur keh rahe honge Allah humne dekh liya aur sun liya ab hamein lauta de toh hum nek a'maal karenge aur kamil yaqeen rakhenge.)))))

Hazrat Alqama farmate hain is hadith ne mujhe bahut si baton se bacha liya.

Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi isay hasan batlatay hain. Ahnaf bin Qais farmatay hain dayin taraf wala nekiyan likhta hai aur yeh bayin taraf walay par ameen hai. Jab banday se koi khata ho jati hai to yeh kehta hai thehar ja, agar us ne usi waqt tauba kar li to usay likhnay nahin deta aur agar us ne tauba na ki to woh likh leta hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Imam Hasan Basri is ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmatay thay, aye Ibn-e-Adam! Teray liye sahifa khol diya gaya hai aur do buzurg farishtay tujh par muqarrar kar diye gaye hain, ek teray dahinay dusra bayin. Dayin taraf wala to teri nekiyon ki hifazat karta hai aur bayin taraf wala buraiyon ko dekhta rehta hai, ab tu jo chahay amal kar, kami kar ya ziyadati kar. Jab tu maray ga to yeh daftar lapet diya jaye ga aur teray sath teri qabr mein rakh diya jaye ga aur Qayamat ke din jab tu apni qabr se uthay ga to yeh teray samnay pesh kar diya jaye ga. Isi ko Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kullu insānin alzamnāhu ṭā'irahū fī 'unuqihī wa nukhriju lahū yaumal-qiyāmati kitābay-yalqāhu manshūrā) (Al-Isra: 13). Har insaan ki shamat-e-a'maal ki tafseel hum ne us ke galay laga di hai aur hum Qayamat ke din us ke samnay namah-e-a'maal ki ek kitab phenk denge jisay woh khuli hui payega. Phir us se kahenge ke apni kitab parh le, aaj tu khud hi apna hisab lenay ko kafi hai. Phir Hazrat Hasan ne farmaya, Allah ki qasam us ne bara hi adl kiya jis ne khud tujhay hi tera muhasib bana diya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmatay hain jo kuch tu bhala bura kalma zaban se nikalta hai woh sab likha jata hai, yahan tak ke tera yeh kehna bhi ke main ne khaya, main ne piya, main gaya, main aaya, main ne dekha. Phir Jumerat walay din us ke aqwal-o-af'aal pesh kiye jatay hain, khair-o-shar baqi rakh li jati hai aur sab kuch mita diya jata hai. Yehi ma'ani hain farman-e-Bari Ta'ala Shanahu ke (Yamḥullāhu mā yashā'u wa yuthbitu wa 'indahū ummul-kitāb) (Ar-Ra'd: 39). Hazrat Imam Ahmad ki babat marwi hai ke aap apne marz-ul-maut mein karah rahay thay to aap ko maloom hua ke Hazrat Ta'oos farmatay hain ke farishtay isay bhi likhtay hain, chunancha aap ne karahna bhi chor diya. Allah aap par apni rahmat nazil farmaye, apni maut ke waqt tak uff bhi na ki.

Phir farmata hai, "Ae insaan! Maut ki behoshi yaqeenan aayegi." Is waqt woh shak door ho jayega jis mein aaj-kal tu mubtala hai. Is waqt tujh se kaha jayega ki yahi hai jis se tu bhagta phirta tha. Ab woh aa gayi, toh kisi tarah is se nijaat nahin pa sakta, na bach sakta hai, na ise rok sakta hai, na ise dafa kar sakta hai, na taal sakta hai, na muqabla kar sakta hai, na kisi ki madad-o-sifarish kuch kaam aa sakti hai. Sahih yahi hai ki yahan khitab mutlaq insaan se hai, agarche baaz ne kaha hai kafir se hai aur baaz ne kuch aur bhi kaha hai. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain, "Main apne walid (Abu Bakr R.A) ke aakhri waqt mein aap ke sarhane baithi thi, aap par ghashi tari hui toh main ne yeh bait padha: 'Man la yazalu dam'uhu saqna'an fa innahu la budda marratan madfooq' (Matlab yeh hai ki jis ke aansu thehre hue hain woh bhi ek martaba tapak padenge). Toh aap ne apna sar utha kar kaha, 'Pyari bachi! Yun nahin, balki jis tarah Allah ne farmaya: (Waja'at sakratul mauti bil haqqi zalika ma kunta minhu tahid) (Surah (Qaf: 19)'." Aur riwayat mein bait ka padhna aur Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ka yeh farmana marwi hai ki yun nahin balki yeh aayat padho. Is asar ke aur bhi bahut se tareeq hain jinhein main ne Seerat-us-Siddiq mein aap ki wafat ke bayan mein jama kar diya hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab maut ki ghashi tari hone lagi toh aap apne chehra-e-mubarak se paseena ponchhte jate aur farmate jate, "SubhanAllah! Maut ki badi sakhtiyan hain."

Is aayat ke pichhle jumle ki tafseer do tarah ki gayi hai: Ek toh yeh ki (Ma) mausoola hai, yani yeh wohi hai jise tu ba'eed-az-imkaan janta tha. Dusra qaul yeh hai ki yahan (Ma) nafiya hai, toh ma'ani yeh honge ki yeh woh cheez hai jis ke juda karne ki, jis se bachne ki tujhe qudrat nahin, tu is se hat nahin sakta. Mu'ajam-e-Kabeer Tabrani mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Us shakhs ki misaal jo maut se bhagta hai, us lomdi jaisi hai jis se zameen apna qarza talab karne lagi aur yeh us se bhagne lagi. Bhagte-bhagte jab thak gayi aur bilkul chakna-choor ho gayi toh apne bhat mein ja ghusi. Zameen chunke wahan bhi maujood thi, us ne lomdi se kaha, 'Mera qarza de', toh yeh wahan se phir bhagi, saans phoola hua tha, haal bura ho raha tha, aakhir yunhi bhagte-bhagte bedam ho kar mar gayi." Al-gharaz, jis tarah us lomdi ko zameen se bhagne ki raahein band thin, isi tarah insaan ko maut se bachne ke raaste band hain.

Is ke baad soor phoonke jaane ka zikr hai, jis ki poori tafseer wali hadith guzar chuki hai. Aur hadith mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Main kis tarah rahat-o-aaram hasil kar sakta hoon halanke soor phoonkne wale farishte ne soor munh mein le liya hai aur gardan jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka intezar kar raha hai ki kab hukm mile aur kab woh phoonk de." Sahaba ne kaha, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hum kya kahein?" Aap ne farmaya, "Kaho: (Wa qalu hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel) (Surah (Al-Imran: 173)."

(Surah (Al-Imran: 173) Phir farmata hai har shakhs ke sath ek farishta toh maidan-e-mahshar ki taraf lane wala hoga aur ek farishta uske a'maal ki gawahi dene wala hoga. Zahir-e-ayat yahi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ne is ayat ki tilawat mimbar par ki aur farmaya ek chalane wala jiske hamrah yeh maidan-e-mahshar mein aayega aur ek gawah hoga jo uske a'maal ki shahadat dega. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain 'Sa'iq' se murad farishta hai aur 'Shaheed' se murad amal hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai 'Sa'iq' farishton mein se honge aur 'Shaheed' se murad khud insaan hai jo apne upar aap gawahi dega. Phir iske baad ki ayat mein jo khitab hai uski nisbat teen qaul hain. Ek toh yeh ke yeh khitab kafir se hoga, dusra yeh ke isse murad aam insaan hain nek-o-bad sab, teesra yeh ke isse murad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hain. Dain aur bayin do farishtay. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke wohi insaan ka khaliq hai aur us ka ilm tamam cheezon ka ihata kiye hue hai, yahan tak ke insaan ke dil mein jo bhale bure khayalat paida hote hain unhein bhi woh jaanta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ke dil mein jo khayalat ayen un se darguzar farma liya hai jab tak ke woh zaban se na nikalein ya amal na karein. Aur hum us ki rag-e-jaan se bhi zyada us ke nazdeek hain, yani hamare farishtay. Aur baaz ne kaha hai hamara ilm. Un ki gharz yeh hai ke kahin hulool aur ittehad na lazim ajaye jo bil-ijma us Rabb ki muqaddas zaat se ba'eed hai aur woh us se bilkul paak hai. Lekin lafz ka iqtiza yeh nahin hai, is liye ke (wa-ana) nahin kaha balkay (wa-nahnu) kaha hai, yani main nahin kaha balkay hum kaha hai. Yehi lafz us shakhs ke bare mein kahe gaye hain jis ki maut qareeb agayi ho aur woh naz'a ke alam mein ho. Farman hai ayat (wa-nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum) al-kh, yani hum tum sab se zyada us se qareeb hain lekin tum nahin dekhte. Yahan bhi murad farishton ka is qadar qareeb hona hai. Jaise farman hai ayat (Inna nahnu nazzalna-dh-dhikra wa inna lahu la-hafizun) (Al-Hijr: 9), yani hum ne zikr ko nazil farmaya aur hum hi us ke muhafiz bhi hain. Farishtay hi zikr Quran-e-Kareem ko le kar nazil hue hain aur yahan bhi murad farishton ki itni nazdeki hai jis par Allah ne unhein qudrat bakhsh rakhi hai. Pas insaan par ek pehra farishtay ka hota hai aur ek shaitan ka. Isi tarah shaitan bhi jism-e-insaan mein isi tarah phirta hai jis tarah khoon, jaise ke sachon ke sachay Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai. Is liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke do farishtay jo dain bayin baithe hain woh tumhare aamal likh rahe hain. Ibn-e-Adam ke munh se jo kalma nikalta hai use mehfooz rakhne wale aur use na chhorne wale aur foran likh lene wale farishtay muqarrar hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa inna alaikum la-hafizin) (Al-Infitar: 10), tum par muhafiz hain buzurg farishtay jo tumhare fe'l se ba-khabar hain aur likhne wale hain. Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Qatada to farmate hain yeh farishtay har nek-o-bad amal likh liya karte hain. Ibn-e-Abbas ke do qaul hain, ek to yehi hai, dusra qaul aap ka yeh hai ke sawab-o-azab likh liya karte hain. Lekin ayat ke zahiri alfaz pehle qaul ki hi ta'eed karte hain kyunke farman hai jo lafz nikalta hai us ke paas muhafiz tayyar hain. Hamare a'maal ke gawah. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad ho raha hai ke jo farishta Ibn-e-Adam ke a'maal par muqarrar hai woh us ke a'maal ki shahadat de ga aur kahe ga ke yeh hai mere paas tafseel bila kam-o-kast hazir hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh us farishte ka kalam hoga jise saiq kaha gaya hai jo us ko mahshar mein le aaya tha. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain mere nazdeek mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke woh us farishte par bhi aur gawahi dene wale farishte dono pe mushtamil hai. Ab Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ke faisle adl-o-insaf se kare ga. (Al-Qiya) tasniya ka seegha hai, ba'az nahvi kehte hain ke ba'az Arab wahid ko tasniya kar diya karte hain jaise ke Hajjaj ka maqoola mashhoor hai ke woh apne jallad se kehta tha (Idriba 'unuqahu) tum dono is ki gardan maar do halankeh jallad ek hi hota tha. Hamare a'maal ke gawah. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad ho raha hai ke jo farishta Ibn-e-Adam ke a'maal par muqarrar hai woh us ke a'maal ki shahadat de ga aur kahe ga ke yeh hai mere paas tafseel bila kam-o-kast hazir hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh us farishte ka kalam hoga jise saiq kaha gaya hai jo us ko mahshar mein le aaya tha. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain mere nazdeek mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke woh us farishte par bhi aur gawahi dene wale farishte dono pe mushtamil hai. Ab Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ke faisle adl-o-insaf se kare ga. (Al-Qiya) tasniya ka seegha hai, ba'az nahvi kehte hain ke ba'az Arab wahid ko tasniya kar diya karte hain jaise ke Hajjaj ka maqoola mashhoor hai ke woh apne jallad se kehta tha (Idriba 'unuqahu) tum dono is ki gardan maar do halankeh jallad ek hi hota tha. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is ki shahadat mein Arabi ka ek sher bhi pesh kiya hai. Ba'az kehte hain ke darasal yeh noon-e-taked hai jis ki tasheel alif ki taraf kar li hai lekin yeh ba'eed hai is liye ke aisa to waqf ki halat mein hota hai. Bazahir yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke yeh khitab oopar wale dono farishton se hoga, lane wale farishte ne ise hisab ke liye pesh kiya aur gawahi dene wale ne gawahi de di to Allah Ta'ala un dono ko hukum de ga ke ise jahannami aag mein daal do jo badtareen jagah hai, Allah hamein mehfooz rakhe. Phir farmata hai ke har kafir aur har haq ke mukhalif aur har haq ke na ada karne wale aur har neki, sila-rehmi aur bhalai se khali rehne wale aur har had se guzar jane wale khwah woh maal ke kharch mein israf karta ho khwah bolne aur chalne phirne mein Allah ke ahkaam ki parwah na karta ho aur har shak karne wale aur har Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ke liye yahi hukum hai ke ise pakar kar sakht azab mein daal do. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke jahannam qayamat ke din logon ke samne apni gardan nikale gi aur ba-awaz-e-buland pukar kar kahe gi jise tamam mahshar ka majma sune ga ke main teen qisam ke logon par muqarrar ki gayi hoon: har sarkash haq ke mukhalif ke liye aur har mushrik ke liye aur har tasveer banane wale ke liye, phir woh un sab se lipat jaye gi. Musnad ki hadith mein teesri qisam ke log woh bataye hain jo zalimana qatl karne wale hon. Phir farmaya us ka sathi kahe ga, is se murad shaitan hai jo us ke sath muwakkal tha, yeh us kafir ko dekh kar apni bara'at kare ga aur kahe ga ke main ne ise nahin behkaya balkeh yeh to khud gumrah tha, batil ko az-khud qabool kar leta tha, haq ka apne aap mukhalif tha. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai ke shaitan jab dekhe ga ke kaam khatam hua to kahe ga Allah ne tum se saccha wada kiya tha aur main to wada khilaf hoon hi, mera koi zor to tum par tha hi nahin, main ne tum se kaha tum ne foran maan liya, ab mujhe malamat na karo balkeh apni janon ko malamat karo, na main tumhein kaam de sakoon ga na tum mere kaam aa sako, tum jo mujhe shareek bana rahe the to main pehle hi se un ka inkari tha, zalimon ke liye alimnak azab hain.

Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala insaan se aur uske saathi shaitan se farmaye ga ke mere saamne na jhagro kyunke insaan keh raha hoga ke Allah isne mujhe jabke mere paas nasihat aa chuki gumrah kar diya aur shaitan se kahe ga Allah maine ise gumrah nahin kiya to Allah unhein tu-tu main-main se rok de ga aur farmaye ga main to apni hujjat khatam kar chuka, Rasoolon ki zabani yeh sab baatein tumhein suna chuka tha, tumhein kitabein bhej di thin aur har har tareeqe se har tarah se tumhein samjha-bujha diya tha. Har shakhs par itmam-e-hujjat ho chuki aur har shakhs apne gunahon ka aap zimmedar hai.

Mutakabbir aur Mutajabbir ka thikana: Chunke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka Jahannam se wa'ada hai ke usay pur kar dega is liye Qayamat ke din jo jinnat aur insaan us ke qabil honge unhein us mein daal diya jaye ga aur Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala daryaft farmaye ga ke ab tu to pur ho gayi? Aur yeh kahe gi ke agar kuch aur gunahgar baqi hon to unhein bhi mujh mein daal do. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein yeh hadith hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Jahannam mein gunahgar daalay jayenge aur woh ziyadati talab karti rahe gi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala apna qadam us mein rakhay ga pas woh kahe gi bas bas. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke us waqt yeh simat jaye gi aur kahe gi teri izzat-o-karam ki qasam bas bas aur Jannat mein jagah bach jaye gi yahan tak ke ek makhlooq paida kar ke Allah Ta'ala us jagah ko abad kare ga. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Jannat aur Dozakh mein ek martaba guftagu hui, Jahannam ne kaha ke main har mutakabbir aur har mutajabbir ke liye muqarrar ki gayi hoon aur Jannat ne kaha mera yeh haal hai ke mujh mein kamzor log aur woh log jo duniya mein zi-izzat na samjhay jatay thay woh dakhil honge. Allah Azza-o-Jal ne Jannat se farmaya tu meri rahmat hai apne bandon mein se jisay chahoon ga is rahmat ke sath nawaz doon ga aur Jahannam se farmaya tu mera azab hai tere sath main jisay chahoon ga azab karoon ga. Haan tum dono bilkul bhar jaogi to Jahannam to na bhare gi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala apna qadam us mein rakhay ga ab woh kahe gi bas bas bas. Us waqt woh bhar jaye gi aur us ke sab jor aapas mein simat jayenge aur Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se kisi par zulm na kare ga. Haan Jannat mein jo jagah bach rahe gi us ke bharne ke liye Allah Azza-o-Jal aur makhlooq paida kare ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein Jahannam ka qaul yeh hai ke mujh mein jabr karne walay, takabbur karne wala badshah aur sharif log dakhil honge aur Jannat ne kaha mujh mein kamzor, za'eef, faqir, maskeen dakhil honge. Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain Allah Ta'ala mujhe apni zaat Qayamat ke din dikhaye ga. Main sajday mein gir paroon ga Allah Ta'ala us se khush hoga phir main Allah Ta'ala ki aisi tareefein karoon ga ke woh us se khush ho jaye ga phir mujhe shafa'at ki ijazat di jaye gi phir meri ummat Jahannam ke oopar ke pul se guzarnay lagay gi, ba'az to nigah ki si tezi se guzar jayenge, ba'az teer ki tarah paar ho jayenge, ba'az tez ghoron se ziyada tezi se paar ho jayenge yahan tak ke ek shakhs ghutnon chalta hua guzar jaye ga aur yeh mutabiq-e-a'maal hoga aur Jahannam ziyadati talab kar rahi hogi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala us mein apna qadam rakhay ga pas yeh simat jaye gi aur kahe gi bas bas aur main hauz mein hoon ga. Logon ne kaha hauz kya hai? Farmaya Allah ki qasam us ka pani doodh se ziyada safaid, shehad se ziyada meetha hai aur barf se ziyada thanda hai aur mushk se ziyada khushbudar hai.

Is par bartan aasman ke sitaron se zyada hain jise iska pani mil gaya woh kabhi pyasa na hoga aur jo isse mahroom reh gaya use kahin se pani nahi milega jo serab kar sake. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain woh kahegi kya mujh mein koi makan hai ki mujh mein ziyadti ki jaye? Hazrat Ikrimah (R.A) farmate hain woh kahegi kya mujh mein ek ke bhi aane ki jagah hai? Main bhar gayi, Hazrat Mujahid (R.A) farmate hain ismein jahannumi dale jayenge yahan tak ki woh kahegi main bhar gayi aur kahegi ki kya mujh mein zyada ki gunjaish hai? Imam Ibn Jareer pehle qaul ko hi ikhtiyar karte hain is dusre qaul ka matlab yeh hai ki goya in buzurgon ke nazdeek yeh sawal iske baad hoga ki Allah Ta'ala apna qadam ismein rakh de ab jo isse puchega ki kya tu bhar gayi toh woh jawab degi ki kya mujh mein kahin bhi koi jagah baaqi rahi hai jis mein koi aa sake? Yani baaqi nahi rahi pur ho gayi. Hazrat Aufi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se riwayat karte hain ki aap ne farmaya yeh us waqt hoga jabki ismein sui ke nake ke barabar bhi jagah baaqi na rahegi. Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai jannat qareeb ki jayegi yani qayamat ke din jo dur nahi hai isliye ki jiska aana yaqeeni ho woh dur nahi samjha jata. (Awwab) ke ma'na rujoo karne wala, tauba karne wala, gunahon se ruk jaane wala. (Hafiz) ke ma'na wadon ka pabind. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair (R.H) farmate hain (Awwab-e-Hafiz) woh hai jo kisi majlis mein baith kar na uthe jab tak ki istighfar na karle. Jo Rahman se bin dekhe darta rahe yani tanhai mein bhi khauf-e-Khuda rakhe. Hadith mein hai woh bhi qayamat ke din Arsh-e-Khuda ka saya payega jo tanhai mein Allah ko yaad kare aur uski aankhein beh niklein aur qayamat ke din Allah ke paas dil salamat lekar jaye. Jo uski jaanib jhukne wala ho. Ismein yani jannat mein chale jao Allah ke tamam azabon se tumhein salamati mil gayi aur yeh bhi matlab hai ki farishte un par salam karenge yeh khulood ka din hai. Yani jannat mein hamesha ke liye ja rahe hain jahan kabhi maut nahi. Yahan se kabhi nikal diye jaane ka khatra nahi jahan se tabdili aur her pher nahi. Phir farmaya yeh wahan jo chahenge payenge balki aur zyada bhi. Kaseer bin Murrah (R.H) farmate hain mazeed yeh bhi ki ahl-e-jannat ke paas se ek badal guzrega jis mein se neda aayegi ki tum kya chahte ho? Jo tum chaho main barsaon, pas yeh jis cheez ki khwahish karenge isse barsegi Hazrat Kaseer (R.H) farmate hain agar main is martabe par pahuncha aur mujhse sawal hua toh main kahunga ki khubsurat khush libas naujawan kanwariyaan barsayi jayen.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain tumhara jee jis parind ko khane ko chahe ga woh usi waqt bhuna bhunaya majood ho jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke agar Jannati aulad chahe ga to ek hi sa'at mein hamal aur bacha aur bachay ki jawani ho jaye gi, Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan Ghareeb batlate hain aur Tirmidhi mein yeh bhi hai ke jis tarah yeh chahe ga ho jaye ga aur aayat mein hai aayat (Lillazeena ahsanu al-husna wa ziyadah). Suhaib bin Sinan Rumi (R.A) farmate hain is ziyadati se murad Allah Kareem ke chehray ki ziyarat hai. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) farmate hain har Jumma ke din unhein deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala hoga yahi matlab Mazeed ka hai. Musnad-e-Shafi'i mein hai Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ek safed aaina le kar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye jis ke beechon beech ek nukta tha. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha yeh kya hai? Farmaya yeh Jumma ka din hai jo khaas aap ko aur aap ki ummat ko bator-e-fazilat ke ata farmaya gaya hai. Sab log is mein tumhare peechay hain Yahood bhi aur Nasara bhi, tumhare liye is mein bohat kuch khair-o-barkat hai, is mein ek aisi sa'at hai ke us waqt Allah Ta'ala se jo manga jaye ga mil jata hai, hamare yahan is ka naam Youm-ul-Mazeed hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha yeh kya hai? Farmaya tere Rab ne Jannat-ul-Firdous mein ek kushada maidan banaya hai jis mein mushki teelay hain, Jumma ke din Allah Ta'ala jin jin farishton ko chahe utarta hai, us ke gird-o-pesh noori mimbar hote hain jin par Anbiya (A.S) ronaq afroz hote hain, yeh mimbar sonay ke hain jis par jadao juray hue hain, Shuhada aur Siddiq log un ke peechay un mushki teelon par honge. Allah Azza-o-Jal farmaye ga main ne apna wada tum se sacha kiya ab mujh se jo chaho mango pao ge. Yeh sab kahen ge hamain teri khushi aur razamandi matloob hai, Allah farmaye ga yeh to main tumhein de chuka main tum se raazi ho gaya, is ke siwa bhi tum jo chaho ge pao ge aur mere paas aur ziyada hai. Pas yeh log Jumma ke khwahish mand rahen ge kyunke unhein bohat si na'amatein isi din milti hain, yahi din hai jis din tumhara Rab Arsh par mustawi hua, isi din Hazrat Adam (A.S) paida kiye gaye aur isi din Qayamat aaye gi. Isi tarah isay Hazrat Imam Shafi'i ne Kitab-ul-Umm ki Kitab-ul-Jummah mein bhi warid kiya hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne is aayat ki tafseer ke moqa par ek bohat bada asar warid kiya hai jis mein bohat si baatein ghareeb hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Jannati sattar saal tak ek hi taraf mutawajja baitha rahe ga phir ek hoor aaye gi jo us ke kandhay par haath rakh kar usay apni taraf mutawajja kare gi, woh itni khubsurat hogi ke us ke rukhsaar mein usay apni shakal is tarah nazar aaye gi jaise aab-dar aainay mein, woh jo zewarat pehney hue hogi un mein ka ek ek adna moti aisa hoga ke us ki jot se saari duniya munawwar ho jaye, woh salam kare gi yeh jawab de kar poochay ga tum kaun ho? Woh kahe gi main hoon jisay Quran mein "Mazeed" kaha gaya tha.

Is par sattar hulle honge lekin tahum is ki khubsurati aur chamak damak aur safai ki wajah se bahar hi se is ka pindli ka guda tak nazar aega is ke sar par jada-o-taj hoga jis ka adna moti mashriq maghrib ko roshan kar dene ke liye kafi hai.

Haan Jannat mein jo jagah bach rahe gi us ke bharne ke liye Allah Azza-o-Jal aur makhlooq paida kare ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein Jahannam ka qaul yeh hai ke mujh mein jabr karne walay, takabbur karne wala badshah aur sharif log dakhil honge aur Jannat ne kaha mujh mein kamzor, za'eef, faqir, maskeen dakhil honge. Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain Allah Ta'ala mujhe apni zaat Qayamat ke din dikhaye ga. Main sajday mein gir paroon ga Allah Ta'ala us se khush hoga phir main Allah Ta'ala ki aisi tareefein karoon ga ke woh us se khush ho jaye ga phir mujhe shafa'at ki ijazat di jaye gi phir meri ummat Jahannam ke oopar ke pul se guzarnay lagay gi, ba'az to nigah ki si tezi se guzar jayenge, ba'az teer ki tarah paar ho jayenge, ba'az tez ghoron se ziyada tezi se paar ho jayenge yahan tak ke ek shakhs ghutnon chalta hua guzar jaye ga aur yeh mutabiq-e-a'maal hoga aur Jahannam ziyadati talab kar rahi hogi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala us mein apna qadam rakhay ga pas yeh simat jaye gi aur kahe gi bas bas aur main hauz mein hoon ga. Logon ne kaha hauz kya hai? Farmaya Allah ki qasam us ka pani doodh se ziyada safaid, shehad se ziyada meetha hai aur barf se ziyada thanda hai aur mushk se ziyada khushbudar hai.

Is par bartan aasman ke sitaron se zyada hain jise iska pani mil gaya woh kabhi pyasa na hoga aur jo isse mahroom reh gaya use kahin se pani nahi milega jo serab kar sake. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain woh kahegi kya mujh mein koi makan hai ki mujh mein ziyadti ki jaye? Hazrat Ikrimah (R.A) farmate hain woh kahegi kya mujh mein ek ke bhi aane ki jagah hai? Main bhar gayi, Hazrat Mujahid (R.A) farmate hain ismein jahannumi dale jayenge yahan tak ki woh kahegi main bhar gayi aur kahegi ki kya mujh mein zyada ki gunjaish hai? Imam Ibn Jareer pehle qaul ko hi ikhtiyar karte hain is dusre qaul ka matlab yeh hai ki goya in buzurgon ke nazdeek yeh sawal iske baad hoga ki Allah Ta'ala apna qadam ismein rakh de ab jo isse puchega ki kya tu bhar gayi toh woh jawab degi ki kya mujh mein kahin bhi koi jagah baaqi rahi hai jis mein koi aa sake? Yani baaqi nahi rahi pur ho gayi. Hazrat Aufi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se riwayat karte hain ki aap ne farmaya yeh us waqt hoga jabki ismein sui ke nake ke barabar bhi jagah baaqi na rahegi. Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai jannat qareeb ki jayegi yani qayamat ke din jo dur nahi hai isliye ki jiska aana yaqeeni ho woh dur nahi samjha jata. (Awwab) ke ma'na rujoo karne wala, tauba karne wala, gunahon se ruk jaane wala. (Hafiz) ke ma'na wadon ka pabind. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair (R.H) farmate hain (Awwab-e-Hafiz) woh hai jo kisi majlis mein baith kar na uthe jab tak ki istighfar na karle. Jo Rahman se bin dekhe darta rahe yani tanhai mein bhi khauf-e-Khuda rakhe. Hadith mein hai woh bhi qayamat ke din Arsh-e-Khuda ka saya payega jo tanhai mein Allah ko yaad kare aur uski aankhein beh niklein aur qayamat ke din Allah ke paas dil salamat lekar jaye. Jo uski jaanib jhukne wala ho. Ismein yani jannat mein chale jao Allah ke tamam azabon se tumhein salamati mil gayi aur yeh bhi matlab hai ki farishte un par salam karenge yeh khulood ka din hai. Yani jannat mein hamesha ke liye ja rahe hain jahan kabhi maut nahi. Yahan se kabhi nikal diye jaane ka khatra nahi jahan se tabdili aur her pher nahi. Phir farmaya yeh wahan jo chahenge payenge balki aur zyada bhi. Kaseer bin Murrah (R.H) farmate hain mazeed yeh bhi ki ahl-e-jannat ke paas se ek badal guzrega jis mein se neda aayegi ki tum kya chahte ho? Jo tum chaho main barsaon, pas yeh jis cheez ki khwahish karenge isse barsegi Hazrat Kaseer (R.H) farmate hain agar main is martabe par pahuncha aur mujhse sawal hua toh main kahunga ki khubsurat khush libas naujawan kanwariyaan barsayi jayen.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain tumhara jee jis parind ko khane ko chahe ga woh usi waqt bhuna bhunaya majood ho jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke agar Jannati aulad chahe ga to ek hi sa'at mein hamal aur bacha aur bachay ki jawani ho jaye gi, Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan Ghareeb batlate hain aur Tirmidhi mein yeh bhi hai ke jis tarah yeh chahe ga ho jaye ga aur aayat mein hai aayat (Lillazeena ahsanu al-husna wa ziyadah). Suhaib bin Sinan Rumi (R.A) farmate hain is ziyadati se murad Allah Kareem ke chehray ki ziyarat hai. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) farmate hain har Jumma ke din unhein deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala hoga yahi matlab Mazeed ka hai. Musnad-e-Shafi'i mein hai Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ek safed aaina le kar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye jis ke beechon beech ek nukta tha. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha yeh kya hai? Farmaya yeh Jumma ka din hai jo khaas aap ko aur aap ki ummat ko bator-e-fazilat ke ata farmaya gaya hai. Sab log is mein tumhare peechay hain Yahood bhi aur Nasara bhi, tumhare liye is mein bohat kuch khair-o-barkat hai, is mein ek aisi sa'at hai ke us waqt Allah Ta'ala se jo manga jaye ga mil jata hai, hamare yahan is ka naam Youm-ul-Mazeed hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha yeh kya hai? Farmaya tere Rab ne Jannat-ul-Firdous mein ek kushada maidan banaya hai jis mein mushki teelay hain, Jumma ke din Allah Ta'ala jin jin farishton ko chahe utarta hai, us ke gird-o-pesh noori mimbar hote hain jin par Anbiya (A.S) ronaq afroz hote hain, yeh mimbar sonay ke hain jis par jadao juray hue hain, Shuhada aur Siddiq log un ke peechay un mushki teelon par honge. Allah Azza-o-Jal farmaye ga main ne apna wada tum se sacha kiya ab mujh se jo chaho mango pao ge. Yeh sab kahen ge hamain teri khushi aur razamandi matloob hai, Allah farmaye ga yeh to main tumhein de chuka main tum se raazi ho gaya, is ke siwa bhi tum jo chaho ge pao ge aur mere paas aur ziyada hai. Pas yeh log Jumma ke khwahish mand rahen ge kyunke unhein bohat si na'amatein isi din milti hain, yahi din hai jis din tumhara Rab Arsh par mustawi hua, isi din Hazrat Adam (A.S) paida kiye gaye aur isi din Qayamat aaye gi. Isi tarah isay Hazrat Imam Shafi'i ne Kitab-ul-Umm ki Kitab-ul-Jummah mein bhi warid kiya hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne is aayat ki tafseer ke moqa par ek bohat bada asar warid kiya hai jis mein bohat si baatein ghareeb hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Jannati sattar saal tak ek hi taraf mutawajja baitha rahe ga phir ek hoor aaye gi jo us ke kandhay par haath rakh kar usay apni taraf mutawajja kare gi, woh itni khubsurat hogi ke us ke rukhsaar mein usay apni shakal is tarah nazar aaye gi jaise aab-dar aainay mein, woh jo zewarat pehney hue hogi un mein ka ek ek adna moti aisa hoga ke us ki jot se saari duniya munawwar ho jaye, woh salam kare gi yeh jawab de kar poochay ga tum kaun ho? Woh kahe gi main hoon jisay Quran mein "Mazeed" kaha gaya tha.

Besud koshish. Irshad hota hai ke yeh kuffar toh kya cheez hain? Un se bohat zyada quwwat-o-taqat aur asbab-o-tadad ke logon ko isi jurm par hum teh-o-bala kar chuke hain jinhon ne shaharoun mein apni yaadgarien chhori thin, zameen mein khoop fasad kiya. Lambe lambe safar karte thay, hamare azab dekh kar bachne ki jagah talash karne lage magar yeh koshish bilkul besud thi, Allah ki qaza-o-qadar aur uski pakar-dohkar se kaun bach sakta tha? 

Pas tum bhi yaad rakho ke jis waqt mera azab agaya baglein jhankte reh jaoge aur bhusi ki tarah ura diye jaoge. Har aqalmand ke liye is mein kafi ibrat hai agar koi aisa bhi ho jo samajhdari ke saath dheyan lagaye woh bhi is mein bohat kuch pa sakta hai yaani dil ko hazir kar ke kanon se sune. 

Phir Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai ke us ne asmanon ko, zameen ko aur uske darmiyan ki cheezon ko chhe roz mein paida kar diya aur woh thaka nahi, is mein bhi maut ke baad ki zindagi par Allah ke qadir hone ka suboot hai ke jo aisi bari makhlooq ko awwalan paida kar chuka hai, us par murdon ka jalana kya bhari hai? 

Hazrat Qatadah ka farman hai ke maloon yahood kehte thay ke chhe din mein makhlooq ko racha kar khaliq ne satwein roz aram kiya aur yeh din hafte ka tha, is ka naam hi unhon ne Yawm-ur-Rahat rakh chhora tha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne unke is wahi khayal ki tardeed ki ke humein thakan hi na thi aram kaisa? Jaise aur ayat mein hai: Wa lam ya'ya bi khalqihin bi qadirin 'ala an yuhyi-al-mawta bala innahu 'ala kulli shai'in qadir (Surah (Al-Ahqaf: 33), yaani kya unhon ne nahi dekha? Ke Allah woh hai jis ne asmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya aur un ki paidaish se na thaka, woh murdon ke zinda karne par qadir nahi? Haan kyun nahi, woh toh har cheez par قادر hai. 

Aur ayat mein hai: La khalqu-as-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqi-an-nasi wa lakinna aksara-an-nasi la ya'lamoon (Surah (Al-Ghafir: 57), albatta asman-o-zameen ki paidaish logon ki paidaish se bohat bari hai. 

Aur ayat mein hai: A-antum ashaddu khalqan amis-sama'u banaha (Surah (An-Nazi'at: 27), kya tumhari paidaish zyada mushkil hai ya asman ki? Usay Allah ne banaya hai. 

Phir farman hota hai ke yeh jhutlane aur inkar karne wale jo kehte hain use sabr se sunte raho aur unhein mohlat do, un ko chhor do aur suraj nikalne se pehle aur doobne se pehle aur raat ko Allah ki paki aur tareef kiya karo. 

Meraj se pehle subh aur asr ki namaz farz thi aur raat ki tahajjud Aap par aur Aap ki ummat par ek saal tak wajib rahi, uske baad Aap ki ummat se is ka wujoob mansookh ho gaya. Uske baad meraj wali raat panch namazen farz huin jin mein fajr aur asr ki namazen joun ki toun rahin.

Pas suraj nikalne se pehle aur doobne se pehle murad Fajr ki aur Asr ki namaz hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein baithe hue thay, aap ne chaudahvin raat ke chand ko dekha aur farmaya tum apne Rab ke samne pesh kiye jaoge aur use is tarah dekhoge jaise is chand ko dekh rahe ho, jis ke dekhne mein koi dhakka-peli nahin. Pas agar tum se ho sake to khabardar suraj nikalne se pehle ki aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namazon se ghafil na ho jaya karo, phir aap ne ayat (وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوْبِهَا ۚ وَمِنْ اٰنَاۗئِ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَاَطْرَاف النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضٰى) (Taha: 130) padhi. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Raat ko bhi is ki tasbeeh bayan kar yani namaz padh, jaise farmaya ayat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ڰ عَسٰٓي اَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدًا) (Al-Isra: 79), yani raat ko Tahajjud ki namaz padha kar, yeh ziyadati khas tere liye hi hai, tujhe tera Rab Maqam-e-Mahmood mein khada karne wala hai. Sandon ke peeche se murad baqol Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) namaz ke baad Allah ki paki bayan karna hai. Un se bohat zyada quwwat-o-taqat aur asbab-o-tadad ke logon ko isi jurm par hum teh-o-bala kar chuke hain jinhon ne shaharoun mein apni yaadgarien chhori thin, zameen mein khoop fasad kiya. Lambe lambe safar karte thay, hamare azab dekh kar bachne ki jagah talash karne lage magar yeh koshish bilkul besud thi, Allah ki qaza-o-qadar aur uski pakar-dohkar se kaun bach sakta tha? 

Pas tum bhi yaad rakho ke jis waqt mera azab agaya baglein jhankte reh jaoge aur bhusi ki tarah ura diye jaoge. Har aqalmand ke liye is mein kafi ibrat hai agar koi aisa bhi ho jo samajhdari ke saath dheyan lagaye woh bhi is mein bohat kuch pa sakta hai yaani dil ko hazir kar ke kanon se sune. 

Phir Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai ke us ne asmanon ko, zameen ko aur uske darmiyan ki cheezon ko chhe roz mein paida kar diya aur woh thaka nahi, is mein bhi maut ke baad ki zindagi par Allah ke qadir hone ka suboot hai ke jo aisi bari makhlooq ko awwalan paida kar chuka hai, us par murdon ka jalana kya bhari hai? 

Hazrat Qatadah ka farman hai ke maloon yahood kehte thay ke chhe din mein makhlooq ko racha kar khaliq ne satwein roz aram kiya aur yeh din hafte ka tha, is ka naam hi unhon ne Yawm-ur-Rahat rakh chhora tha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne unke is wahi khayal ki tardeed ki ke humein thakan hi na thi aram kaisa? Jaise aur ayat mein hai: Wa lam ya'ya bi khalqihin bi qadirin 'ala an yuhyi-al-mawta bala innahu 'ala kulli shai'in qadir (Surah (Al-Ahqaf: 33), yaani kya unhon ne nahi dekha? Ke Allah woh hai jis ne asmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya aur un ki paidaish se na thaka, woh murdon ke zinda karne par qadir nahi? Haan kyun nahi, woh toh har cheez par قادر hai.

Aur ayat mein hai: A-antum ashaddu khalqan amis-sama'u banaha (Surah (An-Nazi'at: 27), kya tumhari paidaish zyada mushkil hai ya asman ki? Usay Allah ne banaya hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein baithe hue thay, aap ne chaudahvin raat ke chand ko dekha aur farmaya tum apne Rab ke samne pesh kiye jaoge aur use is tarah dekhoge jaise is chand ko dekh rahe ho, jis ke dekhne mein koi dhakka-peli nahin. Pas agar tum se ho sake to khabardar suraj nikalne se pehle ki aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namazon se ghafil na ho jaya karo, phir aap ne ayat (وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوْبِهَا ۚ وَمِنْ اٰنَاۗئِ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَاَطْرَاف النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضٰى) (Taha: 130) padhi. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Raat ko bhi is ki tasbeeh bayan kar yani namaz padh, jaise farmaya ayat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ڰ عَسٰٓي اَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدًا) (Al-Isra: 79), yani raat ko Tahajjud ki namaz padha kar, yeh ziyadati khas tere liye hi hai, tujhe tera Rab Maqam-e-Mahmood mein khada karne wala hai. Sandon ke peeche se murad baqol Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) namaz ke baad Allah ki paki bayan karna hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas muflis muhajir aaye aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Maaldar log buland darje aur hamesha wali ne'matein hasil kar chuke. Aap ne farmaya yeh kaise? Jawab diya ke hamari tarah namaz roza bhi to woh bhi karte hain lekin woh sadqa dete hain jo hum nahin de sakte, woh ghulam azad karte hain jo hum nahin kar sakte. Aap ne farmaya aao tumhein ek aisa amal batlaun ke jab tum use karo to sab se aage nikal jao aur tum se afzal koi na nikle lekin jo is amal ko kare. Tum har namaz ke baad taintis taintis martaba SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar padh liya karo. Phir woh aaye aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hamare maaldar bhaiyon ne bhi aap ki is hadith ko suna aur woh bhi is amal ko karne lage. Aap ne farmaya phir yeh to Allah ka fazl hai jise chahe de. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke is se murad Maghrib ke baad ki do rakat hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A), Hazrat Abu Umama (R.A) ka yahi farman hai aur yahi qaul hai Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H) waghera ka. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har farz namaz ke baad do rakat padha karte thay bajuz Fajr aur Asr ki namaz ke. Abdur Rahman farmate hain har namaz ke peeche. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke main ne ek raat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke yahan guzari, aap ne Fajr ke farzon se pehle do halki rakat ada keen, phir ghar se namaz ke liye nikle aur farmaya ae Ibn-e-Abbas! Fajr ke pehle ki do rakat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاِدْبَار النُّجُوْمِ) (At-Tur: 49) hain aur Maghrib ke baad ki do rakat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاَدْبَار السُّجُوْدِ) (Qaf: 40) hain.

Yeh usi raat ka zikr hai jis raat Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne tahajjud ki namaz ki terah raka'at Aap (ﷺ) ki iqtida mein ada ki thin aur us raat Aap (ﷺ) ki khala Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) ki baari thi. Lekin ooper jo bayan hua yeh hadis Tirmizi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmizi isse gharib batlate hain, haan asl hadis tahajjud ki to Bukhari o Muslim mein hai. Mumkin hai ke pichhla kalam Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka apna ho. Wallahu A'lam.)))

Besud koshish. Irshad hota hai ke yeh kuffar toh kya cheez hain? Un se bohat zyada quwwat-o-taqat aur asbab-o-tadad ke logon ko isi jurm par hum teh-o-bala kar chuke hain jinhon ne shaharoun mein apni yaadgarien chhori thin, zameen mein khoop fasad kiya. Lambe lambe safar karte thay, hamare azab dekh kar bachne ki jagah talash karne lage magar yeh koshish bilkul besud thi, Allah ki qaza-o-qadar aur uski pakar-dohkar se kaun bach sakta tha? 

Pas tum bhi yaad rakho ke jis waqt mera azab agaya baglein jhankte reh jaoge aur bhusi ki tarah ura diye jaoge. Har aqalmand ke liye is mein kafi ibrat hai agar koi aisa bhi ho jo samajhdari ke saath dheyan lagaye woh bhi is mein bohat kuch pa sakta hai yaani dil ko hazir kar ke kanon se sune. 

Phir Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai ke us ne asmanon ko, zameen ko aur uske darmiyan ki cheezon ko chhe roz mein paida kar diya aur woh thaka nahi, is mein bhi maut ke baad ki zindagi par Allah ke qadir hone ka suboot hai ke jo aisi bari makhlooq ko awwalan paida kar chuka hai, us par murdon ka jalana kya bhari hai? 

Hazrat Qatadah ka farman hai ke maloon yahood kehte thay ke chhe din mein makhlooq ko racha kar khaliq ne satwein roz aram kiya aur yeh din hafte ka tha, is ka naam hi unhon ne Yawm-ur-Rahat rakh chhora tha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne unke is wahi khayal ki tardeed ki ke humein thakan hi na thi aram kaisa? Jaise aur ayat mein hai: Wa lam ya'ya bi khalqihin bi qadirin 'ala an yuhyi-al-mawta bala innahu 'ala kulli shai'in qadir (Surah (Al-Ahqaf: 33), yaani kya unhon ne nahi dekha? Ke Allah woh hai jis ne asmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya aur un ki paidaish se na thaka, woh murdon ke zinda karne par qadir nahi? Haan kyun nahi, woh toh har cheez par قادر hai. 

Aur ayat mein hai: La khalqu-as-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqi-an-nasi wa lakinna aksara-an-nasi la ya'lamoon (Surah (Al-Ghafir: 57), albatta asman-o-zameen ki paidaish logon ki paidaish se bohat bari hai. 

Aur ayat mein hai: A-antum ashaddu khalqan amis-sama'u banaha (Surah (An-Nazi'at: 27), kya tumhari paidaish zyada mushkil hai ya asman ki? Usay Allah ne banaya hai. 

Phir farman hota hai ke yeh jhutlane aur inkar karne wale jo kehte hain use sabr se sunte raho aur unhein mohlat do, un ko chhor do aur suraj nikalne se pehle aur doobne se pehle aur raat ko Allah ki paki aur tareef kiya karo.

Jab hum sab qabron se nikal khade honge, Hazrat Ka'b Ahbar R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ek farishte ko hukum dega ke Baitul Maqdis ke patthar par khada ho kar yeh aawaz lagaye ke A caret-sadi gali hadiyo aur a-e jism ke mutafarriq ajzao Allah tumhe jama ho jaane ka hukum deta hai taake tumhare darmiyan faisla kar de, pas murad is se Soor hai, yeh haq is shak o shubah aur ikhtilaf ko mita dega jo is se pehle tha, yeh qabron se nikal khade hone ka din hoga. Ibtidaan yeh paida karna phir lautana aur tamam khalaq ko ek jagah laut lana hamare hi bas ki baat hai. Us waqt har ek ko us ke amal ka badla hum denge, tamam bhalai burai ka awaz har har shakhs ko pa lega, zameen phat jayegi aur sab jaldi jaldi uth khade honge. Allah Ta'ala aasmaan se baarish barsayega jis se makhluqaat ke badan ugne lagenge jis tarah keechad mein pada hua dana baarish se ug jata hai. Jab jism ki poori nashv-o-numa ho jayegi toh Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Israfeel A.S ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum dega. Tamam roohein Soor ke surakh mein hongi, un ke Soor phoonkte hi roohein aasmaan ke darmiyan phirne lag jayengi, us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Mere izzat-o-jalal ki qasam har rooh apne apne jism mein chali jayegi jise us ne duniya mein aabaad rakha tha. Pas har rooh apne apne asli jism mein ja milegi aur jis tarah zehreele janwar ka asar chaupaye ke rag o resha mein bahut jald pahunch jata hai, is tarah us jism ke rag o reshe mein foran rooh daud jayegi aur saari makhluq Allah ke farman ke taht daudti hui jald az jald maidan-e-mahshar mein hazir ho jayegi, yeh waqt hoga jo kafiron par bahut hi sakht hoga. Farman-e-Bari hai: (Yowma yad'oukum fatastajeeboonna bihamdihi wa tazunnoona in labistum illa qaleela) (Al-Isra: 52), yaani jis din woh tumhe pukarega tum us ki taareefein karte hue jawab doge aur samajhte hoge ke tum bahut hi kam thehre. Sahih Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain sabse pehle meri qabr ki zameen shaq hogi. Farmata hai ke yeh dobara khada karna hum par bahut hi sahal aur bilkul aasaan hai jaise Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ne farmaya: (Wa ma amruna illa wahidatun kalamhil bil-basar) (Al-Qamar: 50), yaani hamara hukum is tarah yakbarki ho jayega jaise aankh ka jhapakna aur aayat mein hai: (Ma khalqukum wa la ba'thukum illa kanafsin wahidatin inna Allaha Samee'un Baseer) (Luqman: 28), yaani tum sab ka paida karna aur phir marne ke baad zinda karna aisa hi hai jaise Allah Ta'ala ek shakhs ko (paida karna), woh Allah to sab kuch sunne dekhne wala hai. Phir Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hota hai ke ae Nabi ﷺ yeh jo kuch keh rahe hain hamare ilm se baahar nahi, tu ise ahemeyyat na de hum khud nipta lenge jaise aur jagah hai: (Wa laqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloon) (Al-Hijr: 97).

(Al-Hijr: 97), Waqa'i humein maloom hai ke yeh log jo baatein banate hain us se aap tang dil hote hain so is ka ilaj yeh hai ke aap apne Parvardigar ki paki aur tareef karte rahiye aur namazon mein rahiye aur maut aajane tak apne Rab ki ibadat mein lage rahiye. Phir farmata hai toh unhein hidayat par jabran nahi la sakta na hum ne tujhe is ka mukallaf banaya hai. Yeh bhi mani hain ke un par jabr na karo, lekin pehla qaul awla hai kyunke alfazon mein yeh nahi ke tum un par jabr na karo balki yeh hai ke tum un par jabbar nahi ho yaani aap muballigh hain tabligh kar ke apne fareeze se sabakdosh ho jaiye jabr mani mein ajbir ke bhi aata hai. Aap naseehat karte rahiye jis ke dil mein khauf-e-Allah hai jo is ke azabon se darta hai aur is ki rehmaton ka ummeedwar hai woh zaroor is tabligh se nafa uthayega aur rah-e-rast par ajayega jaise farmaya hai ayat (Wa in ma nureyannaka ba'da allazi na'iduhum au natawafayannaka fa innama 'alaika al-balagu wa 'alaina al-hisab 40) (Ar-Ra'd: 40) yaani tujh par sirf pohncha dena hai hisab toh hamare zimme hai aur ayat mein hai ayat (Fazakkir innama anta muzakkir 21) (Al-Ghashiyah: 21) toh naseehat karne wale hain kuch un par darogha nahi. Aur jagah hai tumhare zimme in ki hidayat nahi balki Allah jise chahe hidayat karta hai aur jagah hai ayat (Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinnal-laha yahdee man yashao wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen 56) (Al-Qasas: 56), yaani tum jise chaho hidayat nahi de sakte balki Allah jise chahe rah-e-rast par la khada karta hai. Isi mazmoon ko yahan bhi bayan farmaya hai. Hazrat Qatadah is ayat ko sun kar yeh dua karte (Allahumma aj'alna mimman yakhafu wa'idaka wa yarju maw'idaka ya Barru ya Raheem) yaani اے Allah tu hamein un mein se kar jo teri sazaon ke darawe se darte hain aur teri naimaton ke wade ki umeed lagaye hue hain ae bahut zyada ehsaan karne wale aur ae bahut zyada raham karne wale. Surah Qaf ki tafseer khatam hui. Walhamdulillah wahdahu wa hasbunallah wa ni'mal wakeel.

Aap naseehat karte rahiye jis ke dil mein khauf-e-Allah hai jo is ke azabon se darta hai aur is ki rehmaton ka ummeedwar hai woh zaroor is tabligh se nafa uthayega aur rah-e-rast par ajayega jaise farmaya hai ayat (Wa in ma nureyannaka ba'da allazi na'iduhum au natawafayannaka fa innama 'alaika al-balagu wa 'alaina al-hisab 40) (Ar-Ra'd: 40) yaani tujh par sirf pohncha dena hai hisab toh hamare zimme hai aur ayat mein hai ayat (Fazakkir innama anta muzakkir 21) (Al-Ghashiyah: 21) toh naseehat karne wale hain kuch un par darogha nahi. Aur jagah hai tumhare zimme in ki hidayat nahi balki Allah jise chahe hidayat karta hai aur jagah hai ayat (Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinnal-laha yahdee man yashao wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen 56) (Al-Qasas: 56), yaani tum jise chaho hidayat nahi de sakte balki Allah jise chahe rah-e-rast par la khada karta hai. Isi mazmoon ko yahan bhi bayan farmaya hai. Hazrat Qatadah is ayat ko sun kar yeh dua karte (Allahumma aj'alna mimman yakhafu wa'idaka wa yarju maw'idaka ya Barru ya Raheem) yaani اے Allah tu hamein un mein se kar jo teri sazaon ke darawe se darte hain aur teri naimaton ke wade ki umeed lagaye hue hain ae bahut zyada ehsaan karne wale aur ae bahut zyada raham karne wale. Surah Qaf ki tafseer khatam hui. Walhamdulillah wahdahu wa hasbunallah wa ni'mal wakeel.

Jab hum sab qabron se nikal khade honge, Hazrat Ka'b Ahbar R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ek farishte ko hukum dega ke Baitul Maqdis ke patthar par khada ho kar yeh aawaz lagaye ke A caret-sadi gali hadiyo aur a-e jism ke mutafarriq ajzao Allah tumhe jama ho jaane ka hukum deta hai taake tumhare darmiyan faisla kar de, pas murad is se Soor hai, yeh haq is shak o shubah aur ikhtilaf ko mita dega jo is se pehle tha, yeh qabron se nikal khade hone ka din hoga. Ibtidaan yeh paida karna phir lautana aur tamam khalaq ko ek jagah laut lana hamare hi bas ki baat hai. Us waqt har ek ko us ke amal ka badla hum denge, tamam bhalai burai ka awaz har har shakhs ko pa lega, zameen phat jayegi aur sab jaldi jaldi uth khade honge. Allah Ta'ala aasmaan se baarish barsayega jis se makhluqaat ke badan ugne lagenge jis tarah keechad mein pada hua dana baarish se ug jata hai. Jab jism ki poori nashv-o-numa ho jayegi toh Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Israfeel A.S ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum dega. Tamam roohein Soor ke surakh mein hongi, un ke Soor phoonkte hi roohein aasmaan ke darmiyan phirne lag jayengi, us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Mere izzat-o-jalal ki qasam har rooh apne apne jism mein chali jayegi jise us ne duniya mein aabaad rakha tha. Pas har rooh apne apne asli jism mein ja milegi aur jis tarah zehreele janwar ka asar chaupaye ke rag o resha mein bahut jald pahunch jata hai, is tarah us jism ke rag o reshe mein foran rooh daud jayegi aur saari makhluq Allah ke farman ke taht daudti hui jald az jald maidan-e-mahshar mein hazir ho jayegi, yeh waqt hoga jo kafiron par bahut hi sakht hoga. Sahih Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain sabse pehle meri qabr ki zameen shaq hogi. Phir Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hota hai ke ae Nabi ﷺ yeh jo kuch keh rahe hain hamare ilm se baahar nahi, tu ise ahemeyyat na de hum khud nipta lenge jaise aur jagah hai: (Wa laqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloon) (Al-Hijr: 97).
